messages:
maria (Docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR for the offline installer bundle + systemd unit examples. Need 1-2 reviewers for accuracy on KMS/HSM snippets and checksum verification flow. PR: http://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/812 :wave:

dev-docs-bot: Automated link check for PR #812: 2 broken links found (/install/old-ports -> 404). See CI link: http://ci.internal/job/docs-linkcheck/812

Ashok: I'll take a look, especially the PKCS#11 placeholder and systemd unit. Quick Q: are we recommending SHA256 or SHA512 for bundle checksums?

maria (Docs): SHA256 is ok for now but we should include both examples. Also add a note about verifying signatures if customers use HSM-signed manifests.

Kevin: FYI CI ran local smoke. ops-ci reports network tests passed except one failing port on testnet. ops-ci: see results -> http://ci.internal/job/installer-offline/457 :robot_face:

ops-ci: testnet failed for port 179 -> calico-iface. Appears on kernels <5.10. Adding a note in the troubleshooting section would help.

Ashok: For PKCS11 snippet I'm including an example with /usr/lib/pkcs11/redwood.so and the token label. Here's the suggested snippet:
```bash
# PKCS11 config
module: /usr/lib/pkcs11/redwood.so
slot: 0
token: "redwood-hsm"
pin: "<HSM_PIN>"
```

Kevin: For bundle checksum add these commands to docs:
```bash
# create archive
tar -czf redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz redwood-bundle/
# create checksum
sha256sum redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz > redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz.sha256
# verify
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz.sha256
# (optional: sha512 example)
sha512sum redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz > redwood-offline-2026.tar.gz.sha512
```

maria (Docs): Nice — please also include systemd unit snippet for a service that extracts the bundle on first boot:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood Offline Installer Extract
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-extract /opt/redwood
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

Ashok: One more: apt mirror example for air-gapped install (mirror all packages). Add the release signing step too:
```bash
# create Packages index and Release
apt-ftparchive packages ./pool > Packages
gzip -c Packages > Packages.gz
apt-ftparchive release ./ > Release
# sign the Release (detached ASCII sig)
gpg --default-key <KEYID> -abs -o Release.gpg Release
```

maria (Docs): Please add a short troubleshooting bullet: 'If apt clients report 404, ensure Release and Packages.gz are in same directory and that base URL in sources.list ends with /'.

Kevin: Also update the port matrix doc to call out calico tunneled vs host-gw differences. I'll file a follow-up PR referencing kernel constraints.

ops-ci: re: testnet port 179 failure — kernel logs: https://kernel.logs/12345 (internal). Suggest adding note: 'If you see port bind failures on kernels <=5.4, try host networking (--net=host) or upgrade kernel to >=5.10.'

maria (Docs): Great. Who can be lead reviewer so we can merge? @Ashok?

Ashok: happy to be lead. I'll do a pass tonight and push small wording fixes.

maria (Docs): Thanks :thumbsup: I'll wait for your review then merge.

Kevin: One final nit — include a one-line example for verifying a detached GPG signature for the Release file:
```bash
gpg --verify Release.gpg Release
```

maria (Docs): Added both the sha256 & sha512 examples and the GPG verification note. Pushed a tiny README update to the PR. pinging reviewers. :bell:
